howto.what: 它把 Discord 适配器从 channels 分支复制到 src/channels/、注册并构建测试，然后引导你创建 Discord 机器人、粘贴 Bot Token，凭此自动推导 App ID 与公钥并写入 .env，重启服务后你就能在 Discord 私信里和 Claude 对话。
howto.when: 当你想给项目接入 Discord 机器人频道时；若正在走 /setup 流程，则在其中执行。适配器不在主干里，需靠本技能复制进来。

howto.what_en: Copies the Discord adapter from the `channels` branch into `src/channels/`, registers and builds it, then guides you through creating a Discord bot, pasting the Bot Token, storing credentials, and restarting so it can DM you.
howto.when_en: Use when you want a Discord bot channel in this project, or run it inside the /setup flow. The adapter isn't shipped in trunk, so this skill copies it in.
